column1: # A 293-row SLICE of public.jurisdictions, read-only from ycadmmngkdhvpcsrcuaq
# 2026-10-08. The live table has 39,507 rows and 38,887 at the three matchable
# levels; committing all of them would put a megabyte of Census reference data
# in a test fixture to answer questions about 41 headlines.
# ⚠️ THE SLICE IS CHOSEN SO THE ANSWERS DO NOT CHANGE, and that is a real
# constraint, not a convenience. attribution-pure.ts decides ambiguity by
# counting how many STATES carry a name NATIONALLY, so a slice that dropped one
# state's "Union County" would turn an honest refusal into a false attribution —
# the exact failure the module exists to prevent. So the slice is:
#   (a) EVERY row nationally for each of the 19 phrases these 41 headlines
#       contain ("union" is here 20 times, in 20 states, on purpose), and
#   (b) EVERY row whose name begins with a full state name plus a space —
#       the complete universe the compound-place guard consults, so
#       "Michigan City" (IN and ND), "Texas City", "Kansas City", "Iowa City",
#       "Nevada City" and "Oklahoma City" all resolve exactly as they do live.
# comment block; never hand-edit a row.
